card.title: Not Until You Explain
card.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

mechanism: A prevents a hurried signature and departure until B accounts for an undisclosed wedding-date change.
confusable: Unlike mere disagreement with the new date, A must pursue concealment while keeping B in the room.
comparison: A shared wedding and work deadline create accountability pressure, rather than a missing hour and offered ride.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
